'''Evan Maltby''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Maltby was born and is currently living in New York. He became a voice actor as an adult and joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}. There, he gained his first role as [[Team Skull]] boss [[Guzma]].
